cohort: The study included 478 women who underwent peripartum hysterectomy at a tertiary care centre in Northern India between January 2013 and December 2022.
finding: Rupture uterus (45.8%) and morbid adherent placenta (19%) were the most common indications for peripartum hysterectomy, which was associated with significant maternal and neonatal complications including ICU care (47.2%) and stillbirth (57.9%).
